notes.title: POLYGLOCK 1.01 Minor Update
notes.content: [list][*][p]Added additional support for more fonts and languages[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Huge New Custom Content Builder
notes.content:
[h1]Custom Content Builder[/h1][p]This new update features a custom content builder that allows you to create/share/edit/import your own material. This means you can use POLYGLOCK as a flash card/aim trainer not only to learn Japanese through the officially supported suite, but to learn anything you want to. That could be learning another language, studying for University or simply some fun trivia. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558059/353f59983a7b69dfe64c4eb3c4d0c083594548e0.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558059/37ceeefd260b0129fbd2326e9d45dba2a36b222c.jpg"][/img]
[b]New Keyboard Visuals[/b][/p][p]The in-game keyboard has been updated from the 2d layout to 3d, complete with animations and sound effects to replicate an actual keyboard. You can choose from a variety of different key press sounds in the options.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558059/f1ce4e0d62f97ac55e79fe74e16f9b2f615b345f.jpg"][/img]
[b]Other Updates
[/b]Additionally, there have been innumerable small tweaks and improvements made to the front and backend of the game. Most notably, there have been significant improvements to performance, especially when using the endless mode.[/p]
